outcome: adverse outcomes (conversion to multiport/laparotomy, intra-operative injury, DVT, UTI, incisional cellulitis)
diagnosis of malignancy on final pathology
cohort: The study participants were women at high genetic or familial risk for ovarian/tubal/primary peritoneal cancer or with a personal history of breast cancer who underwent single-port laparoscopic risk-reducing salpingo-oophorectomy with or without hysterectomy.
finding: Single-port laparoscopy is a safe option for women undergoing risk-reducing salpingo-oophorectomy with or without hysterectomy.
